text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
……I reckon it's about time to head back. 
Yeah, I can really feel it, I've made much 
more progress compared to usual.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Though… "You can quit once you're bored of it", you say. Hahah, I bet you have thought quite hard about this one.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Wahh, what a coincidence! Hello. You out here hiking as well?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hiking…… Since we're talking about 
Stego here, wouldn't it be more correct 
to say that she's on a journey?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yo you guys. This is more or less just 
training though. Trainer prepped the 
course for me.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
If you change your environment, then your 
mood goes along with it. Thanks to that, I 
think I've made some good progress. I was 
just about to head back but ——

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Since you guys are here, do you wanna 
give my special training course a go?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh no no! We were also just on our way 
back. It was just that we wanted to ask 
if you knew of any shortcuts around here…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh? If that's the case, then this'll be 
perfect. See that rope over there? It's 
sturdy alright, I've done many round 
trips with it.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Once you climb that rope, you'll see a 
lake up there, and if you run along it, 
you can get back much faster 
compared to taking the normal path.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: For my trainer to even consider the route back, pretty thoughtful of them right? Hahah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Y-Y-You've done this rope trip multiple 
times…!? You're truly something. We 
can't be backing down now can we, Mirako!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ehhhhhhhhh!? I-I-I don't think I'll need to try so hard with this right～～～!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It'll save you about an hour y'know～ 
Shall we go? A journey is better with 
company after all.
